about.en: EL is the token of ELYSIA, a protocol for tokenizing real-world assets such as real estate and bringing real-world finance on-chain; the token is used for protocol fees, rewards and governance. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x2781246fe707bb15cee3e5ea354e2154a2877b16, with deployments on BNB Chain and TON.
